unit.why: An anecdote told by R. Menahem Mendel of Kosov's son about his father, who receives petitioners while bedridden and explains to a puzzled visitor that he never left devekut.

stories.start_quote: פ״א היה אבא ז״ל מוטל במטתו
stories.summary_en: A son tells of his father, the tsaddik R. Menahem Mendel (of Kosov). Lying weak in bed before prayer, the father answers many petitioners. A visitor, R. Hayyim Leib, wonders how he can speak of worldly matters while occupied with upper worlds. The tsaddik explains that he never left devekut, just as one can say the liturgy while one's thoughts wander.
